format: linkedin copy-paste, bullet markers lost, plain Title Case headings
note: Headings are plain known labels (What You'll Do / What We're Looking For / Nice to Have / Benefits). Title Case items ('Strong Communication Skills', 'Team Player', 'Unlimited PTO') are NOT headings: Title Case alone never makes a heading. Responsibilities are unscored per contract. MATLAB is in keywords.json and sits only in Benefits, so it is excluded and not in found.
posting_text:
About the job
Acme Robotics is hiring a Mechanical Design Engineer in Austin, TX.
What You'll Do
Design sheet metal and machined parts in SolidWorks
Perform FEA and tolerance stack-up analysis
Create drawings with GD&T per ASME Y14.5
What We're Looking For
BS in Mechanical Engineering
Proficiency with SolidWorks or Creo
Strong Communication Skills
Nice to Have
Team Player
Experience with CFD or thermal analysis
Python scripting
Benefits
Medical, Dental, Vision
Unlimited PTO
Annual Learning Stipend for MATLAB Courses
Acme is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
